title: Software Engineer, Data & Observability Platforms — MTS/SMTS
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Software Engineering    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.         Job Summary    We’re hiring a Software Engineer at either the Member of Technical Staff (MTS) or Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) level to join the IT Employee Success (ES) & Finance Platform, Data and Innovations team. The final level will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, technical depth, demonstrated scope, and leadership capabilities.      Our team builds the platforms that power Employee Success and Finance systems. We’re evolving our observability capabilities beyond traditional dashboards and reactive alerts toward intelligent, agent-assisted operations—including proactive issue detection, root-cause analysis, and insights informed by historical telemetry.      We’re also building a unified data platform that integrates data from Workday, Salesforce, and other enterprise systems to support operational workflows, reporting, analytics, and emerging AI and agentic use cases.      This role is a strong fit for an engineer with a platform-first mindset and experience in—or a strong interest in—data platforms, telemetry, observability, cloud infrastructure, and open-source technologies.      About the Role    You’ll be a hands-on technical contributor building reliable, reusable, and scalable platform capabilities for Employee Success and Finance systems.    At the MTS level, you’ll contribute to the design and implementation of platform components, collaborate with experienced engineers, and take increasing ownership of services and technical outcomes.      At the SMTS level, you’ll lead the design of significant platform capabilities, drive technical decisions across teams, mentor engineers, and influence the long-term architecture and direction of the platform.      What You’ll Do     Design, build, and operate telemetry, observability, logging, and alerting systems that provide real-time visibility into system health, reliability, and performance.    Advance our observability platform beyond dashboards and reactive monitoring toward proactive, AI- and agent-assisted issue detection, investigation, and root-cause analysis.    Build and evolve data pipelines and platform services that integrate data from Workday, Salesforce, and other enterprise systems.    Enable operational, reporting, analytics, and emerging AI and agentic use cases through reliable, secure, and well-governed data.    Build and improve CI/CD pipelines with integrated quality gates, including automated testing, security scanning, and vulnerability checks.    Develop scalable and maintainable infrastructure and services using open-source technologies, primarily on AWS, with some workloads on GCP.    Partner with Employee Success, Finance, security, data, and other engineering teams to identify platform gaps and improve developer experience, data reliability, and operational intelligence.    Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, and technical planning.    Apply and promote engineering best practices related to code quality, testing, security, reliability, and operational excellence.    Contribute to reusable technical patterns, standards, and documentation across the platform.       Core Qualifications     Professional software development experience building and operating production systems.    Proficiency in one or more relevant programming languages, such as Java, Python, or Go.    Experience with—or a strong interest in—observability, telemetry, logging, alerting, data pipelines, or data platforms.    Familiarity with open-source technologies and modern software engineering practices.    Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and foundational security or vulnerability-management practices.    Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS; GCP experience is a plus.    Understanding of distributed systems, scalability, reliability, and system-design principles.    Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering and business teams.    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.       Level-Specific Expectations    MTS     Typically 3–5 years of professional software development experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability.    Experience implementing well-defined services, platform components, or data pipelines.    Ability to deliver reliable solutions with guidance from senior engineers.    Willingness to incorporate feedback and develop deeper expertise in platform, data, and observability engineering.    Ability to take ownership of components and contribute effectively to technical discussions and code reviews.       SMTS     Typically 8 or more years of professional software development experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability.    Demonstrated experience designing and operating scalable platforms, shared services, infrastructure, or developer capabilities used by multiple teams.    Ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives from architecture through production operation.    Strong architectural judgment and the ability to make pragmatic tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, security, and delivery.    Experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders, driving technical alignment, and establishing reusable engineering standards.    Ability to mentor other engineers and raise the technical effectiveness of the broader team.       Nice to Have     Experience applying AI or agentic approaches to observability, incident investigation, monitoring, or operational tooling.    Experience integrating Workday, Salesforce, or other enterprise and third-party systems.    Experience with MuleSoft or a similar enterprise integration platform.    Experience with Kubernetes or another container-orchestration platform.    Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.             Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.    Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.       In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits.  Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program.
